tasks.taskText: XMLParser.parse() accepts non-string input that has a toString method, but when a plain Uint8Array (for example the output of TextEncoder.encode) is passed, the parser stringifies it as a comma-separated list of byte values instead of decoding the bytes, so parsing fails or produces garbage. Make parse() treat a Uint8Array as UTF-8 encoded XML text: multi-byte characters (accented letters, emoji) must round-trip correctly; only the bytes inside the given view must be decoded (respect byteOffset and length of a subarray); a leading UTF-8 byte order mark must be preserved in the decoded string so that captureMetaData startIndex values match those obtained when the equivalent string is parsed directly; validation (validator.validate) must accept the same bytes it would accept as a string and reject malformed XML. Node.js Buffer input must keep working exactly as before. Source is under src/; tests run with npm test (jasmine).
